package worker_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"

	"github.com/Suhaibinator/Next.go/offline"
	"github.com/Suhaibinator/Next.go/offline/worker"
)

type recoveredModelBackend struct {
	base             *modelBackend
	pair             any
	clientCalls      int
	changeAfterFirst bool
}

func (b *recoveredModelBackend) Call(op string, arg any) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	if op != "clients" {
		return b.base.Call(op, arg)
	}
	b.clientCalls++
	if b.pair != nil {
		return modelJSON(b.pair)
	}
	raw, err := b.base.Call(op, arg)
	if b.changeAfterFirst && b.clientCalls == 1 {
		// A second read would authenticate one set but persist another. The
		// recovered transition must retain the exact originally returned pair.
		b.base.browser.clients = []string{"replacement"}
		b.base.browser.visible = []string{"replacement"}
	}
	return raw, err
}

func recoveredModelMessage(t *testing.T, e *worker.Engine, bundle modelBundle, sender string) worker.Status {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"url": "https://example.test/guide", "id": sender})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return worker.RecoveredDisableForTest(e, bundle.command("disable-recovered", "recovery-1"), string(raw))
}

func TestRecoveredDisableUsesOneNativePairAndRetainsRealHelper(t *testing.T) {
	browser := newModelBrowser()
	bundle := newModelBundle(t, "recovery", offline.Budget{})
	_, base := enableModel(t, browser, bundle)
	browser.clients = []string{"parent", "helper", "other-tab", "last-tab"}
	browser.visible = append([]string{}, browser.clients...)
	backend := &recoveredModelBackend{base: base, changeAfterFirst: true}
	engine, err := worker.NewEngine(bundle.raw, backend)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	beforeRemoves := browser.opCount("remove")
	status := recoveredModelMessage(t, engine, bundle, "parent")
	if status.Error != "" || status.Enabled || status.State != "disabled" || !status.DeferredCleanup {
		t.Fatalf("native-bound disable failed: %+v", status)
	}
	if backend.clientCalls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("read clients %d times", backend.clientCalls)
	}
	var retained []string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(browser.index(t)["retained"], &retained); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := []string{"parent", "helper", "other-tab", "last-tab"}
	if !bytes.Equal(mustJSON(t, retained), mustJSON(t, want)) {
		t.Fatalf("did not retain original pair including helper: %v", retained)
	}
	if browser.opCount("remove") != beforeRemoves {
		t.Fatal("disabled clients lost charged payload storage")
	}
	asset := bundle.catalog.Spec().Assets[0]
	retainedAsset := worker.Request{URL: asset.URL, Method: "GET", Mode: "no-cors", Destination: "script", ClientID: "helper"}
	if got := browser.cachedBody(t, engine.Fetch(retainedAsset)); !bytes.Equal(got, bundle.bodies[asset.URL].bytes) {
		t.Fatal("the retained helper lost its charged runtime bytes")
	}
	// Helper removal alone proves no client erasure. Explicit reconciliation
	// must preserve bytes while that exact retained ID remains visible.
	browser.clients = nil
	browser.visible = []string{"helper"}
	if got := modelMessage(engine, bundle, "disable"); got.Error != "" || !got.DeferredCleanup || browser.opCount("remove") != beforeRemoves {
		t.Fatalf("visible helper was exempted from retained accounting: %+v", got)
	}
	browser.visible = nil
	if got := modelMessage(engine, bundle, "disable"); got.Error != "" || got.DeferredCleanup || len(browser.caches) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("explicit reconciliation after all retained IDs closed failed: %+v", got)
	}
}

func mustJSON(t *testing.T, value any) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return raw
}

func TestRecoveredDisableRefusesBeforeStorageMutation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name, sender, code string
		pair               any
	}{
		{"wrong-native-worker", "parent", "sender-uncontrolled", map[string]any{"controlled": 1, "clientIDs": []string{"other"}, "visibleIDs": []string{"parent", "other"}}},
		{"helper-counts-over-cap", "parent", "client-capacity", map[string]any{"controlled": 5, "clientIDs": []string{"parent", "helper", "a", "b", "c"}, "visibleIDs": []string{"parent", "helper", "a", "b", "c"}}},
		{"sequential-pair-inconsistent", "parent", "clients-unavailable", map[string]any{"controlled": 2, "clientIDs": []string{"parent", "helper"}, "visibleIDs": []string{"parent"}}},
		{"duplicate-controlled", "parent", "clients-unavailable", map[string]any{"controlled": 2, "clientIDs": []string{"parent", "parent"}, "visibleIDs": []string{"parent"}}},
		{"duplicate-visible", "parent", "clients-unavailable", map[string]any{"controlled": 1, "clientIDs": []string{"parent"}, "visibleIDs": []string{"parent", "parent"}}},
		{"count-mismatch", "parent", "clients-unavailable", map[string]any{"controlled": 2, "clientIDs": []string{"parent"}, "visibleIDs": []string{"parent"}}},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			browser := newModelBrowser()
			bundle := newModelBundle(t, test.name, offline.Budget{})
			_, base := enableModel(t, browser, bundle)
			backend := &recoveredModelBackend{base: base, pair: test.pair}
			engine, err := worker.NewEngine(bundle.raw, backend)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			before := mustModelJSON(t, browser.index(t))
			writes, removes, puts, creates := browser.opCount("writeRecord"), browser.opCount("remove"), browser.opCount("put"), browser.opCount("create")
			status := recoveredModelMessage(t, engine, bundle, test.sender)
			if status.Error != test.code {
				t.Fatalf("refusal %+v, want %s", status, test.code)
			}
			if backend.clientCalls != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("read clients %d times", backend.clientCalls)
			}
			if browser.opCount("writeRecord") != writes || browser.opCount("remove") != removes || browser.opCount("put") != puts || browser.opCount("create") != creates || mustModelJSON(t, browser.index(t)) != before {
				t.Fatal("native sender/capacity refusal changed durable storage")
			}
			if got := modelMessage(engine, bundle, "status"); !got.Enabled || got.Error != "" {
				t.Fatalf("refusal changed enabled pack: %+v", got)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestRecoveredDisableCannotUseLegacyURLOnlyEntry(t *testing.T) {
	browser := newModelBrowser()
	bundle := newModelBundle(t, "legacy-entry", offline.Budget{})
	engine, _ := enableModel(t, browser, bundle)
	before := len(browser.calls)
	got := engine.Message(bundle.command("disable-recovered", "recovery-1"), "https://example.test/guide")
	if got.Error != "unsupported-command" || len(browser.calls) != before {
		t.Fatalf("URL-only entry admitted recovery or touched backend: %+v", got)
	}
}

func TestRecoveredDisablePreservesOwnerIdentityAndRoleRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name, code string
		mutate     func(*worker.Command)
		active     bool
	}{
		{"owner", "invalid-message", func(c *worker.Command) { c.OwnerPolicyID = "another" }, true},
		{"runtime", "identity-changed", func(c *worker.Command) { c.RuntimeID = "another" }, true},
		{"configuration", "identity-changed", func(c *worker.Command) { c.ConfigurationID = "another" }, true},
		{"request", "invalid-message", func(c *worker.Command) { c.RequestID = "bad request" }, true},
		{"waiting", "waiting-worker", func(*worker.Command) {}, false},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			browser := newModelBrowser()
			bundle := newModelBundle(t, test.name, offline.Budget{})
			_, base := enableModel(t, browser, bundle)
			base.active = test.active
			backend := &recoveredModelBackend{base: base, pair: map[string]any{"controlled": 1, "clientIDs": []string{"parent"}, "visibleIDs": []string{"parent"}}}
			engine, err := worker.NewEngine(bundle.raw, backend)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			command := bundle.command("disable-recovered", "recovery-1")
			test.mutate(&command)
			writes, removes := browser.opCount("writeRecord"), browser.opCount("remove")
			got := worker.RecoveredDisableForTest(engine, command, `{"url":"https://example.test/guide","id":"parent"}`)
			if got.Error != test.code || backend.clientCalls != 0 || browser.opCount("writeRecord") != writes || browser.opCount("remove") != removes {
				t.Fatalf("authority refusal changed work: %+v", got)
			}
		})
	}
}
